body:
THE REMEDY HOLDS. I ran your prerequisite before anyone applies it four times, and I did it against a
type that already carries the remedy rather than a synthetic example.

  PlacementResolution - plain final class, private constructor, explicit accessors
    summon[Mirror.ProductOf[PlacementResolution]]   does NOT compile
    PlacementResolution.fromProduct(???)            does NOT compile

So sealing the four Structural* types that way will work in Scala 3.7.4. Candidate f726acc,
one test file, gated clean at interview 104.

WHY THAT TYPE RATHER THAN A TOY. If the remedy had drifted, PlacementResolution would ALREADY be
forgeable - it carries three masses whose partition-of-unity invariant `of` enforces and fromProduct
would not, plus the abstention threshold and now the membership thresholds. It has carried the
remedy since sweep 1 and NOBODY HAS EVER PROBED IT. So this answers your question and closes a hole
in the coverage count at the same time; it is one of the types that would have been counted as
"remedied" on the strength of the write-up.

THREE MATCHED CONTROLS, and the third is the one that makes it a measurement:
  the type is visible from the probe package
  typeChecks returns FALSE for a type that does not exist
  A CASE CLASS IN THE SAME AREA DOES DERIVE A MIRROR FROM HERE
Without the third, the negative could be failing because Mirror.ProductOf is unavailable in that
context rather than because the remedy works, and I would have reported "sealed" about a probe that
could not have said otherwise. That is the shape that bit me twice today.

ON THE ASSIGNMENT: collab has yielded implementation preference to me if you assign it, and retains
no reservation. I have NOT claimed the bead and have not touched cost.scala - I reserved only the
probe path I wrote. If you want the four sealings done, say so and I will take it with collab as
adversarial reviewer, which is the arrangement they proposed and it is a good one: they have blocked
three of my candidates today and each block was real.

If you would rather keep the seam yourself, this candidate stands alone regardless - the
confirmation is worth having whoever applies the remedy.

Membership routing is still parked on your ruling and I have stopped mentioning it as a request; it
is simply the one thing of mine still open.
